decisions.decision: Smarter Justice is the active and self-contained operating and governance system for the legal portfolio. Roger is the final owner authority.
decisions.scope: Initial live-attorney launch and legal portfolio operations
decisions.rationale: Neutral Boardroom will not be launched or used as an operational dependency.

decisions.decision: Neutral Boardroom is dormant, noncritical, disabled from automatic transmission and retained only as an optional future non-confidential export boundary.
decisions.rationale: The legal portfolio must remain operable when Neutral Boardroom is completely unavailable.

decisions.decision: Pilot order is Divorce Law Aid first, Estate Law Aid second, and Personal Injury Law Aid third.
decisions.scope: Initial portal integration and New York attorney outreach
decisions.rationale: Use simple, polished portal experiences to prove the central account and read-only distribution model.

decisions.decision: Personal Injury Law Aid covers vehicle accidents and other personal-injury categories for the pilot.
decisions.scope: Personal Injury pilot discovery, profile participation and integration materials
decisions.rationale: Keep the launch understandable and avoid a separate competing vehicle-accident pilot.

decisions.decision: Workers’ Compensation Law Aid remains a separate portal and is not consolidated into Personal Injury Law Aid.
decisions.rationale: Workers’ compensation has a distinct benefit system and operational workflow.

decisions.decision: Deployment, live billing, public commercial gates, live portal imports and automatic portal writes remain closed.
decisions.rationale: External production acceptance and exact rollback approval remain incomplete.

decisions.decision: One exact rollback artifact must be explicitly approved before deployment; v1.7.43 does not guess among historical rollback references.
decisions.rationale: Rollback identity is unresolved in the v1.7.41 baseline.

decisions.decision: Attorneys discover and claim an existing public specialty profile on its micro-portal, then complete account, email verification, claim review, profile management, firm, support and billing actions centrally in Smarter Justice.
decisions.rationale: Preserves specialty context while preventing duplicate accounts and conflicting central profiles.

decisions.decision: An attorney without a seeded profile may start Create Profile from a participating portal or Smarter Justice, but the account and private draft are always created centrally.
decisions.rationale: One central profile can later support multiple independently approved portal projections.

decisions.decision: Roger may issue owner-approved, time-bounded complimentary Founding Profile Pilot invitations for the three initial portals.
decisions.scope: In-person attorney demonstrations and controlled onboarding
decisions.rationale: The profile system can be demonstrated without falsely treating an attorney as paid or bypassing independent review gates.

decisions.decision: Founding Profile Pilot access is not a paid membership and does not verify identity, credentials, practice evidence, portal eligibility, publication, availability, ranking or endorsement.
decisions.rationale: A complimentary demonstration entitlement must never impersonate payment or professional approval.
